changelog: Closed notch, your way: show your current to-do, an AI agent's live step (Pro), and turn off the music visualizer or charging alerts (Settings → General → Closed notch).
Weather works without the Windows Weather app, plus a new Weather tab with 24-hour and 7-day forecasts.
Left and right notch: percentages on the closed notch, and no more cut-off panels.
Pro: your custom notch size now stays when the notch is idle.
Notchy: choose which agents ask for approval in the notch; agents that approve their own steps no longer pop up a card at every step.
Fewer "not responding" reports around sleep and lock.
